_what: v2 fleet: 5 trend bots sized off NON-CORE capital + a passive SPY core. Decisions once per day on the near-complete bar (last 20 min of the session); risk management every tick. Validated as variant D in research/PROFIT-REVIEW-2026-10-06.md; run `python3 fleet.py backtest` to reproduce.

core._note: Beta, not alpha: this is simply being half long the market. Band is in fraction-of-equity points: rebalance only when the core drifts outside 40%..60% of equity. The research variant bought once and never rebalanced; a wide band is the closest live equivalent that still handles deposits and large drift.

defaults._event_note: Event gating defaults OFF in v2: the 2026-10-06 review found the FOMC/CPI gate fitted after the fact and flat in the tuning window. Set event_block_days > 0 and populate event_dates to re-enable.

_guardrails: Hard-capped in code regardless of this file: max_daily_loss_pct <= 10, portfolio_max_loss_pct <= 15, risk_pct <= 4 (SOXL) / <= 2 (others), max_gross_pct <= 100. Bots only ever trade their own symbol; the core only ever trades its symbol; nothing else in the account is touched.
